tweet.text: As an example, we applied this to NanoGPT. We estimate the marginal returns to human labor as roughly $2500K per 1% optimization, from interviewing NanoGPT contributors. Using this estimate, the best models have crossover points (expenditure horizon) around $2-$3K, although models may be overfit to the public NanoGPT challenge.
